title: Solar Power Plant (235 kWp)
description: A 235 kWp solar installation of three plants generates clean, renewable energy on campus and reduces the institution's carbon footprint. The plants were commissioned in 2014 (15 kWp), 2018 (100 kWp) and 22 April 2026 (120 kWp).
outcomes: Monthly generation, KSEB import and the solar share of electricity are published on the solar statistics page.

title: Sewage Treatment Plant (50,000 LPD)
description: A 50,000 litres-per-day plant treats campus waste water, with an aerobic upflow filter, a tertiary settling tank and a filter feed tank.
outcomes: Waste water is treated for clean and safe discharge, and treated water is reused, promoting water conservation.

title: Rainwater Harvesting (11 Lakh litres)
description: A rainwater harvesting system with a stated capacity of 11 Lakh litres collects rainwater from roofs and recharges groundwater.
outcomes: Conserves natural resources by recharging groundwater with roof rainwater.

title: Bio-Gas Plant (41 m³)
description: A 41 m³ bio-gas plant converts organic waste into clean cooking gas.
outcomes: Reduces waste, provides clean cooking gas and improves soil health through the digested slurry.
